_comment: toggl_project is the project NAME exactly as it appears in Toggl, and it is
the field that actually works: every integration the extension ships passes
projectName, none passes projectId, so its core resolves by name. An id on
its own produces a timer with no project. toggl_project_id is optional.
First matching rule wins in file order, so put epic rules above key_prefix
rules. Matchers: project_contains, title_contains, parent, key_prefix, tag.
Resolved at sync time, so edit this and re-sync.
